note: Version 1 niche packs only. A new niche is added only after its pack is researched, sourced, and tested with a real product in that niche. Do not add niches by copying another pack and changing the name. Each pack has its own tone guidance and its own template order. Keyword starting points come only from the seller's own product words, so the list starts empty in every pack. No pack is launched for AI generation until sample outputs have been reviewed for grammar, tone, and accuracy against a real product. See docs/ai-copy.md.

packs.description: Planners and sheets for weddings and events.

mockup_notes.flat-feature-frame: Use for one sheet close up, for example a single planning sheet.
mockup_notes.laptop-alone: Use for the desktop view of the planner.
mockup_notes.laptop-plus-phone: First choice for the hero. The pair shows the planner on desktop and on phone together.
mockup_notes.phone-alone: Use for the mobile view, so buyers see the planner on a phone.
mockup_notes.tablet-alone: Use for feature close ups, with the sheet large on screen.

packs.name: Wedding and events
packs.source_notes: Chosen as a version 1 test niche in PROMPT.md section 12, decided by Ali 2026-11-05. Pack content is not yet researched or tested with a real product.

template_notes.bundle-all-tabs: Show every tab at a glance, with the real tab count only.
template_notes.feature-close-up: First choice after the hero. Show one planning sheet large, with one benefit line.
template_notes.features-grid: Show the main planning features as cards, using only confirmed features.
template_notes.final-call-to-action: Close with the real facts, no new claim.
template_notes.hero: First image. Laptop plus phone, large screens, title above the devices.
template_notes.how-it-works: Show the buyer journey in three steps: download, open, plan.
template_notes.mobile-view: Show the planner on a phone, for buyers who plan on the move.
template_notes.sizes-and-formats: State the real format and file facts, nothing else.
template_notes.what-is-inside: List what the planner contains, using the real tab names.
template_notes.who-it-is-for: Name who the planner is for, using only what the product does.

packs.tone_guidance: Warm and practical. Name what the planner helps the buyer organise for the event, using only the seller's confirmed features. Keep the tone calm and helpful, never salesy, and never promise an outcome.
